actions.action: Press the stem gently at several spots and fingernail-test it to check for mushiness
Repot in spring/summer into a pot 2–4 cm wider with well-draining mix (soil plus perlite/bark), loosening outer roots
Check soil and water thoroughly until it drains when the top 3–5 cm is dry
Alternatively bottom water for 20–30 minutes to wet the dense root ball
Use rainwater or filtered water instead of tap water
Place the plant in bright, indirect light
Check the stem base every few weeks for mushiness
If the stem turns mushy, cut above the rot and root the healthy top
Fertilize lightly about once a month in the growing season
If dark wet spots or sour smell appear, post a close-up photo

reason: The answer calls the plant basically healthy, mentioning dry roots and root-binding only as a side point, and the soak/repot fix is present but diluted among routine care tips (short bottom watering, repot deferred), though nothing given would worsen the plant.
